integrity: Theorem supported by a complete analytic proof; finite-grid script is supplementary, not a substitute for the all-model argument.
scientific_limitations: Supremum error over all pointed fuzzy Kripke models, with n distinct variables; Zadeh base contains no intermediate truth constants; other fuzzy modal semantics and restricted models are not covered. Historical priority is not independently established.
title: Exact three-language approximation gap for strong fuzzy disjunction
